leaderboards.name: Code Arena (WebDev) · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes between two web apps built from the same prompt. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Agent Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Inverse-propensity score from real agent sessions in which people keep or reject the work. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes between two answers to people's own prompts, all categories. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · instruction following
leaderboards.what: Votes on prompts with explicit instructions. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · creative-writing prompts
leaderboards.what: Votes on creative-writing prompts; votes reward style and length. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · writing, literature and language
leaderboards.what: Votes on writing, literature and language prompts; votes reward style and length. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · longer query
leaderboards.what: Votes on longer prompts; a proxy for long inputs, not a document test. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · coding
leaderboards.what: Votes on coding prompts in a chat; not repository work. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text Arena · math
leaderboards.what: Votes on maths prompts; answers are not checked for correctness. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Vision Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes on prompts with an image. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Vision Arena · OCR
leaderboards.what: Votes on image prompts that need text read from the image. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Vision Arena · diagrams
leaderboards.what: Votes on prompts about diagrams. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Document Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes between two answers about an uploaded document. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Search Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes between two answers from models with web search. Style control on. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Text-to-Image Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes between two images generated from the same prompt. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.

leaderboards.name: Image Edit Arena · overall
leaderboards.what: Votes between two edits of the same image. Preference votes, not a pass rate: a rating relative to the other models on the same leaderboard and date.
